title: Ujray Ghar Chali Band Bohay
body:
kaliya har sham guzardi eh
<<DIVIDER>>
3.dukh kaun sunhey sugra deh enu kaun
dilasey deh
<<DIVIDER>>
sab turgey dehs paraey hun teek na murkey
aaey
ujri da koi na dardi eh
<<DIVIDER>>
4.hai rab janey khaverey kyu
aaj deeva ney balda
<<DIVIDER>>
sir pitdi eh gabrakey maa salma nu gal laakey
dukriye hokey bhardi eh
<<DIVIDER>>
5.aqdas pal rehgey toorey ujri di zindagi deh
manzoor beemar bari eh edey sir teh moth
kari eh enu fir vi tang akbar di eh
